parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: The sphere is the main part of the globe, typically made of plastic with a printed world map on its surface.
parts.Functional_description: It represents the Earth and can rotate around its axis to display different regions of the world.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates smoothly around a tilted axis supported by the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the supporting structure of the globe, usually made of wood or metal, providing stability.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the rotating sphere in place and allows it to spin freely while maintaining balance.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides a fixed support for the rotating sphere.
